title: ATK and HP
body: ⌊base × (1 + Σ%) + Σflat⌋: every battle ATK% buff shares one pool.

title: DEF
body: max(⌊base × (1 + Σ%) + Σflat⌋, 0): shred past 0 is wasted.

title: Crit rate, crit DMG, crit RES, boss DMG, element DMG, accuracy, avoidance
body: base × (1 + Σ%) + Σflat, in basis points.

title: Skill amp, skill haste, accuracy %, avoidance %, focus %, resist %
body: base + Σflat: no % multiplier on these.

title: Final DMG
body: base + Σflat: no % multiplier.

title: DMG RES and element RES
body: Screen: 1 − (1 − base) × Π(1 − bonus), clamped to 0–100%. Two 30% sources make 51%.

title: Knockback and airborne RES
body: Screen, like DMG RES, clamped to 0–100%.

title: A buff's size: ⌊value × base × (1 + caster amp)⌋
body: Base is 1 or the caster's ATK, DEF or HP. The caster's amp counts, not the receiver's; no level, crit or boss term.

title: No amp on debuffs or lift RES lines; likely none on final DMG
body: Debuffs never take amp (hard-coded); push/airborne RES and heal-cut lines add raw, final DMG lines most likely too (inferred). A server list can exclude more stats.

title: Buffs are sized when the buffer casts
body: Her stats are copied at cast. Buffs she holds then enlarge that cast; later buffs don't grow buffs already out.

title: Same buff again: replace and stack
body: New value, fresh duration, stack +1 up to the cap; every stack takes the newest value, whoever cast it.

title: Same group: only the biggest counts
body: Largest stack × strength wins, caster amp and ATK included; the rest switch off. Ungrouped buffs sum.

title: Debuff chance = rate × (focus ÷ resist + focus% − resist%)
body: Caster's focus at cast, target's resist live; tenacity shortens debuffs. Amp plays no part.

title: Expected crit = 1 + CDR × (CR − CRES)
body: Linear in crit rate with no cap at 100%; below 0 it is ×1.

title: Tiers: the floor, plus a chance at one more
body: 200% crits twice every hit; 198% crits once, and a second time 98% of the time.

title: Raise whichever of effective crit rate (crit rate − target crit RES) and crit DMG is lower
body: Per equal point, crit rate wins while CDR > CR − CRES, crit DMG after. Break-even is CR − CRES = CDR, not 100%.

title: C_def, C_inc, C_dec and the penalty tiers
body: Server data, not in the client; each has a measurement plan.

title: Does Light gain on the Dark Piñata?
body: Only if C_dec plus the boss's element RES is 0. Test a Light cookie against an equal Fire one.
